<!--
Shared global calibration-run selector, spliced into every report page via
{{< include _calib_run_selector.qmd >}} (a literal text splice before
Quarto's own processing, so these cells execute in the including page's own
kernel/OJS runtime -- not a separate document). Requires the including page
to have already defined a Python `calib_runs` list (every report page's
config cell already does: `calib_runs = vs.list_available_runs(repo_root)`)
before this include point.

Produces `globalCalibRun` (an OJS value, via `viewof`) -- every chart/table
on the page should filter by this instead of defining its own per-section
run selector. Persists the choice across page navigation via localStorage
(each Quarto page is a separate static HTML load, so this is what makes one
control feel global across the whole site rather than resetting on every
page).
-->

```{python}
#| echo: false
ojs_define(calib_runs_ojs=calib_runs)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof globalCalibRun = {
  const options = calib_runs_ojs;
  if (options.length === 0) {
    return Inputs.select([], {label: "Calibration Run:", disabled: true});
  }
  const stored = window.localStorage.getItem("tdmcalib:selectedRun");
  const initial = options.includes(stored) ? stored : options[options.length - 1];
  const input = Inputs.select(options, {label: "Calibration Run:", value: initial});
  input.classList.add("calib-run-bar");
  input.addEventListener("input", () => {
    window.localStorage.setItem("tdmcalib:selectedRun", input.value);
  });
  return input;
}
```
